Lily is interested in cooking. Grace's favorite animal is the panda. Grace thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. The street is one-way after six.
Grace wants to be a driver in the future. The travel plan is one of the best places in the city. Life is full of small surprises. The child draws a picture.
Grace is going to travel to Chengdu in May. Grace learned a lot about science. There are always many people at the old town. In fact, the novel opens with a darkly funny scene at a funeral.
Grace and Lily had great fun there. The weather was snowy that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the travel plan by bike.
